channel.title: The Times and Democrat - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Times and Democrat (thetandd.com)

item.title: 100 OBJECTS/ DAY 77: Branch Junction makes Raylrode Daze unique
item.description: This feature about the history of Branchville's Branch Junction was initially published in the Times and Democrat series in 2014, as part of "100 Objects in 100 Days."

item.title: 100 OBJECTS/Day 92: SCSU stadium named for legendary coach Oliver C. Dawson
item.description: Oliver Cromwell Dawson served for many years as a professor, athletic director, coach and administrator at South Carolina State College.

item.title: 100 OBJECTS/DAY 48: Orangeburg has rich history in aviation
item.description: The history of Orangeburg aviation dates back to the 1930s, with significant milestones including the founding of the Breakfast Club and the Aviation Memorial at Orangeburg Municipal Airport.

item.title: VINTAGE ORANGEBURG COUNTY/DAY 83: Patriotism stopped 1937 fight spurred by ‘the man in the brown suit’
item.description: In 1937, a football game between USC and The Citadel was interrupted by a spectator in a brown suit, leading to a fight and a patriotic moment before the game resumed.

item.title: 100 OBJECTS/DAY 40: Elloree Heritage Museum exhibits depict early rural life
item.description: The Elloree Heritage Museum & Cultural Center showcases rural life in South Carolina from 1800s-1900s. Award-winning museum with hands-on exhibits, art gallery, and historic artifacts.

item.title: V-shaped tree marks grave of Voorhees’ visionary founder
item.description: In 2013, a mysterious V-shaped tree grew near Elizabeth Evelyn Wright's grave at Voorhees College, symbolizing divine intervention and honoring the school's legacy.

item.title: Tales about Stroman House abound; most of them untrue
item.description: The Stroman House, a Neo-Classical residence built in 1926, was home to landowners in Orangeburg County, known for its tragic history and rumored paranormal activity.

item.title: S.C. State no stranger to turmoil
item.description: The history of South Carolina State University from 2003-2012 includes presidency changes, financial scandals, accreditation challenges, and internal investigations.

item.title: 100 OBJECTS/DAY 21: British commander used Bruce House as headquarters
item.description: The Donald Bruce house, oldest in Orangeburg County, holds historical significance with ties to Revolutionary War, British occupation, and relocation, featuring unique 18th-century architecture.

item.title: The trouble with hogs
item.description: Dr. John Rheney discusses the increase of wild hog populations and offers advice on hunting, handling, and cooking wild pigs.
